'''Chapter 990''' is titled "Army of One".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[["Gang" Bege's Oh My Family]] Vol. 34: "Hang on tight!! Mama told us our father is a clingy man who never gives up, no matter how many times he's kicked!!"

[[Charlotte Chiffon|Chiffon]], [[Charlotte Lola|Lola]], and the [[Fire Tank Pirates]] help [[Pound]].

==Short Summary==
Upon witnessing [[Jack]] in his mammoth form overpower the [[Guardians]] and [[Inuarashi Musketeer Squad|Musketeer Squad]], [[Inuarashi]] and [[Nekomamushi]] transform into their [[Sulong]] forms and decide to face him. [[King]] orders the [[Tobiroppo]] to prevent anyone from pursuing [[Kaidou]] on the roof of the Skull Dome. The Straw Hats continue their battle against the [[Numbers]], where [[Monkey D. Luffy]] goes into [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques|Gear 4]]. Meanwhile, [[X Drake]] is confronted by [[Queen]] and [[Who's-Who]], who reveal that Drake is a traitor, having previously freed [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]]. During his escape, Drake encounters Luffy and requests to join his side.

==Long Summary==
A group of [[Beasts Pirates]] members found [[Sasaki]]. The lackeys told him that the battle inside the [[Onigashima#Skull Dome|Skull Dome]] has already begun. Sasaki wonders how [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] destroyed the tree that restrained him. He also told that [[Denjiro|Kyoshiro]] betrayed him, as well as his affiliation to [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]]'s [[Nine Red Scabbards|Scabbards]]. He was also told that the battle between Kaidou's group and the Scabbard-led group has already begun.

At the top of the Skull Dome, the battle continues between Kaidou's group and the Scabbard-led group, with the minks fighting in their [[Sulong]] forms. While the minks' combined forces have beaten a number of opponents, [[Jack]] and his [[Zou Zou no Mi, Model: Mammoth|mammoth form]] overpowers them. [[Kin'emon]] prepares to join the fight but [[Inuarashi]] and [[Nekomamushi]] prevent the rest of the Scabbards from doing so. The two then transform into their Sulong forms.

On the balcony of Kaidou's Castle, [[Queen]] notes that all the prisoners from the [[Prisoner Mine]] have escaped. [[King]] then bullies Queen for not being able to stop the mass breakout from happening. Queen then wonders if the prisoners threatened [[Babanuki]] into saying that the breakout did not happen. King contacts the [[Beasts Pirates#Tobiroppo|Tobiroppo]] through the [[Den Den Mushi]]. Meanwhile in one of the rooms inside the castle, [[X Drake]] tells [[Basil Hawkins]] that Onigashima is in chaos and that this is the best time for anyone to turncoat. Hawkins then replies that he does not need to. He also tells Drake that there's only a one percent chance that an unnamed person survives until tomorrow. Drake then picks up the Den Den Mushi. After picking up, King tells all the Tobiroppo that Onigashima is being intruded by 5,000 people. In comparison, their forces are at 30,000. He then cancels their opportunity to challenge the All Stars after capturing [[Yamato]].

Somewhere within the [[Onigashima#Live Floor|Live Floor]], [[Ulti]] reacts to the announcement. [[Page One]] tells her that it should be expected. Ulti then asks Page One to give her another piggyback ride after seeing Yamato climb up a wall, much to Page One's dismay. King then tells all the Tobiroppo to prevent the [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance|intruding alliance]] from entering the roof of the Skull Dome. Meanwhile, [[Who's-Who]] invites Drake to come with him to meet with Queen to find out who he wants to eliminate.

On the Live Floor, the Udon prison escapees and Denjiro's Yakuza team clash with members of the Beasts Pirates, [[Mimawarigumi]] and the [[Orochi Oniwabanshu]]. The escapees and the Yakuza tell the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] not to waste their energy on the lackeys and focus on getting to the castle. However the [[Numbers]] notice them. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] slices a Number's mace while [[Jinbe]] prevents it from crushing them and their allies. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] notes that the two [[Numbers]] are somewhat similar to [[Oars]], which the Straw Hats barely managed to beat together back in [[Thriller Bark]]. He then transforms to [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 4 Techniques|Gear 4]]. [[Hyougoro]] notices that his form looks like a [[wikipedia:Wisdom King|Myōō]].

Just before Luffy delivers his attack, Drake has been beaten by Who's-Who and Queen after meeting the latter. He was questioned by Hawkins about his objectives, especially with freeing [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]]. Drake realizes that all three of them wanted to kill him. But before the three can retrieve more information about his intents and dispose of him, Drake manages to escape by destroying one of the castle windows and jumping to the Live Floor. Before he manages to land, he attacks [[Juki]] with his saber and four-bladed axe in his hands. At the same time, Luffy delivers his attack.

After beating the Numbers, X Drake expresses his intent to fight alongside Luffy.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Sasaki]] has been freed from his chains.
*[[Inuarashi]] and [[Nekomamushi]] transform into their [[Sulong]] forms and attack [[Jack]].
*[[Basil Hawkins|Hawkins]] is present on [[Onigashima]].
**He predicts that the chance of a certain man surviving up to the next day is 1%.
*[[King]] orders the [[Tobiroppo]] to cease their search for [[Yamato]] and declares that the opportunity to challenge an All-Star has been cancelled.
*The [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance]] fight against the [[Numbers]].
*[[X Drake|Drake]] is revealed to be the one whom [[Queen]] and [[Who's-Who]] wanted to kill and they attacked him.
**Who's-Who accuses Drake of helping [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]] back in Rasetsu Town.
**Drake flees and attacks one of the Numbers alongside [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]].
*Having become an enemy of the [[Beasts Pirates]], Drake requests to fight alongside Luffy.
